data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 depends on a conceptual correction that SRC_006 lacks: SRC_003 shares mechanism with SRC_006 but explicitly corrects the sub-counting slip by retaining the initial 99 pages in the final total. SRC_003 depends on SRC_006 because both inherit the same 189/603 digit split, but SRC_003 carries an additional dependence on the lineage-ref requirement that every page contributing digits must be counted as a physical page. This corrective relation is refuted if SRC_006 does not share the same 189/603 allocation mechanism, or if the two sources reduce to identical derivations with no meaningful divergence in how the subtotal pages are retained.
